title: Medieval Parchment Yields Ancient Sheeppox Virus DNA, Rewriting Livestock Disease History
description: Scientists extracted sheeppox virus DNA from medieval parchment in famous manuscripts like the York Gospels. The genomes trace the pathogen back 3,500 years to the dawn of intensive wool production. Parchment proves a stable archive for ancient animal viruses.

title: Angkor Wat marathon: 6,500 runners race through Cambodia’s ancient Khmer empire
description: Under the cloak of darkness, runners gather in their hundreds at the entrance to the Angkor Wat temple complex, in Cambodia’s Siem Reap.
